safe_initial_check: Successful caller order remains VALIDATE -> poll validated/owner -> ARM16 -> local serial/context marker staging -> later source wait. The CPU cannot append another ARM while it is blocked in that wait.
If already published/copying at entry, the complete packet reservation allows producer to finish without GPU draining; no force publication is needed.
If validated and unpublished, ARM may be awaiting credit held by older staged markers. The one forced flush publishes all staged commands in order, allowing those packets to drain.
A raw/preflight owner cannot become armed asynchronously: ARM is CPU-controlled. Therefore checking once before the loop is sufficient.
Fallback ACK may leave a briefly visible validated owner; an extra harmless flush is allowed, but no deferred publication remains a liveness dependency.
